title: MEDI-Q Founded
description: MD Jahedul Alam establishes MEDI-Q as a sister concern of Service & Corporation, with a focus on importing quality surgical instruments and medical devices.

title: First Hospital Partnership
description: MEDI-Q secures its first major supply agreement with a leading Dhaka teaching hospital, validating product quality and after-sales service commitments.

title: Nebulizer Range Launch
description: MEDI-Q launches its signature nebulizer product line, quickly growing to become the largest nebulizer range in Bangladesh with multiple models.

title: Nationwide Distribution
description: Expansion of distribution network to cover all 8 divisions of Bangladesh, making MEDI-Q products available to healthcare providers nationwide.

title: COVID-19 Response
description: MEDI-Q rapidly scales PPE imports and ventilator support to assist Bangladesh's healthcare system during the global pandemic, supplying critical equipment to over 50 hospitals.

title: 13-Model Nebulizer Range Complete
description: MEDI-Q completes the country's largest nebulizer range with 12 distinct models covering home care, pediatric, clinical, and ICU requirements.

title: Manufacturing Vision Announced
description: MEDI-Q announces its long-term vision to transition toward local manufacturing of surgical instruments and medical devices in Bangladesh.
